description: Bài học: quãng đường gấp 4 thì thời lượng chỉ gấp khoảng 2, tỷ lệ với căn bậc hai quãng đường.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-distance, written here): Three dots travel 60 / 120 / 240 px from the same start in 300 / 420 / 600 ms power2.inOut. Rule: duration ≈ base × √(distance / reference): 200 px → 300 ms, 800 px → 600 ms. Params: base (0.3 s cho 200 px) · distance. Duration ≈ base × √(distance / reference): four times the distance takes about twice as long.
